title: Donner des consignes avec des pronoms
summary: Move reflexive and object pronouns correctly in affirmative and negative commands.
objectives: Use all three imperative persons with reflexive verbs.
Attach y and en to affirmative commands with correct spelling.
Return pronouns to their preverbal order in negative commands.

sources.label: University of Texas: imperative forms and pronoun placement
University of Texas: object pronoun order

sections.title: Three persons, no spoken subject pronoun
paragraphs: The imperative gives instructions, invitations or suggestions to tu, nous or vous. Normally use the corresponding present form without the subject. Drop the tu final s for -er verbs and verbs whose tu form ends in -es, such as ouvrir; aller has va. Keep it in finis and prends. Common irregular commands are être: sois, soyons, soyez; avoir: aie, ayons, ayez; savoir: sache, sachons, sachez.

In an affirmative reflexive command, attach the pronoun after the verb with a hyphen. Te becomes toi: lève-toi. Nous and vous remain nous and vous. In a negative command, ne comes first, the reflexive pronoun moves before the verb, and pas follows it: ne te lève pas. Do not attach toi after a negative verb.
points: Se lever, to get up: lève-toi, levons-nous, levez-vous; ne te lève pas, ne nous levons pas, ne vous levez pas.

Se souvenir, to remember: souviens-toi, souvenons-nous, souvenez-vous; ne te souviens pas, ne nous souvenons pas, ne vous souvenez pas. The negative forms are grammatical but only useful in an appropriate instruction context.
Vocabulary: une consigne (feminine), an instruction; un échantillon (masculine), a sample.

examples.english: Sit yourself down near the window.
examples.note: Tu command: no s, then hyphen and toi.

examples.english: Let's get ready before the group arrives.
examples.note: A nous command includes the speaker.

examples.french: **Ne vous dépêchez pas**; nous avons le temps.
examples.note: Negative reflexive vous precedes the verb.

mistakes.why: The negative command uses te before the verb, not toi after it.

sections.title: Affirmative y and en follow the command
paragraphs: Y replaces a place or an appropriate à + thing phrase; en replaces an appropriate de phrase or a quantity noun. In an affirmative command, put them after the verb with a hyphen: allez-y, prenez-en. Add s to a tu command ending in a vowel when it is immediately followed by y or en: vas-y, penses-y, manges-en, aies-en.

The s is not added when y or en belongs to a following infinitive rather than to the imperative: Va en chercher means go and fetch some. With two attached pronouns, use direct object le/la/les before moi/toi/lui/nous/vous/leur, then y, then en where that combination is meaningful. Moi and toi become m' and t' immediately before en or y: donne-m'en, va-t'en. Do not mechanically combine every pronoun slot.
points: Aller with y: vas-y, allons-y, allez-y. Prendre with en: prends-en, prenons-en, prenez-en.
Se servir de + noun, to help oneself to/use: sers-t'en, servons-nous-en, servez-vous-en.
In everyday instructions, splitting a cumbersome two-pronoun command into two sentences is often clearer.

examples.english: The office is open: go there now.
examples.note: Va gains s directly before attached y.

examples.english: There is bread left: have some.
examples.note: En replaces a quantity of bread.

examples.french: Ces biscuits sont pour toi: **manges-en** un.
examples.english: These biscuits are for you: eat one.
examples.note: The quantity un remains; mange gains s.

examples.english: I need a sample: give me one.

examples.french: **Va en chercher** deux dans le placard.
examples.english: Go and fetch two from the cupboard.
examples.note: En belongs to chercher, so va has no added s or hyphen.

mistakes.why: An affirmative tu command directly followed by en gains an s for the link.

sections.title: Negative commands restore the usual pronoun order
paragraphs: With ne ... pas, put object pronouns before the imperative as in an ordinary statement. The order is me/te/se/nous/vous, then le/la/les, then lui/leur, then y, then en, selecting only the pronouns actually needed. Ne stands before the pronoun group and pas after the verb.

There is no affirmative-command hyphen between these preverbal pronouns. A tu -er verb has no linking s because y or en no longer follows it: n'y pense pas, n'en mange pas. Do not change the verb to an infinitive.
points: Y and en may elide the preceding ne to n': n'y va pas, n'en prends pas.
A negative imperative remains a direct instruction; a conditional request may sound gentler.

examples.french: **Ne le lui donnez pas** sans explication.
examples.english: Don't give it to him or her without an explanation.

examples.note: Y precedes va, so no added s.
Me elides before en, both before the verb.

sections.title: S'asseoir et rattacher le pronom au bon verbe
paragraphs: S'asseoir, to sit down, has two accepted imperative families. For tu, nous and vous: assieds-toi / asseyons-nous / asseyez-vous, or assois-toi / assoyons-nous / assoyez-vous. Negative commands are ne t'assieds pas / ne nous asseyons pas / ne vous asseyez pas, or ne t'assois pas / ne nous assoyons pas / ne vous assoyez pas. Both families are standard; the tasks accept either unless they explicitly ask for one.

With an imperative followed by a reflexive infinitive, the reflexive pronoun belongs to the infinitive and stays before it: va te sécher, allons nous changer, allez vous installer. The imperative aller has no attached reflexive pronoun in that pattern. This can present going to do something rather than simply ordering the action; it is not automatically more polite in every tone or context.
points: Vocabulary: un siège (masculine), a seat. In an actual instruction, use one full form rather than reading the slash-separated alternatives aloud.

examples.french: **Assieds-toi / Assois-toi** sur le siège près de la prise.
examples.english: Sit on the seat near the socket.
examples.note: Both imperative forms address one familiar person.

examples.french: **Ne vous asseyez pas / Ne vous assoyez pas** sur ce banc fraîchement peint.
examples.english: Don't sit on this freshly painted bench.
examples.note: Negative vous precedes the verb in either family.

examples.french: **Allez vous installer** dans la petite salle.
examples.english: Go and settle in the small room.
examples.note: Vous belongs to s'installer, not to aller; there is no hyphen.

mistakes.avoid: Allez-vous installer dans la petite salle !
mistakes.prefer: Allez vous installer dans la petite salle !
mistakes.why: For the intended command go and settle, vous is the infinitive's reflexive pronoun. A hyphen after allez would suggest subject inversion instead.

practice.prompt: Give the affirmative tu command of se préparer, with no extra words.
practice.explanation: Drop tu and final s; attach toi.

practice.prompt: Replace à l'accueil with y: Va à l'accueil.
practice.explanation: Va gains s before attached y.

practice.prompt: Replace du café with en: Prenez du café.
practice.explanation: Attach en with a hyphen.

practice.prompt: Make the command negative with ne ... pas: Donne-le.
practice.explanation: Le moves before the verb in the negative.

practice.prompt: Give the negative vous command of se lever using ne ... pas.
practice.explanation: Reflexive vous comes before levez.

practice.prompt: Give the affirmative nous command of se reposer.
practice.explanation: Nous follows the affirmative imperative with a hyphen.

practice.prompt: Replace à cette solution with y: Pense à cette solution.
practice.explanation: Pense gains a linking s before y.

practice.prompt: Replace des poires with en: Achète des poires.
practice.explanation: Achète gains s before attached en.

practice.prompt: Make negative with ne ... pas: Vas-y.
practice.explanation: Y moves before va; the linking s disappears.

practice.prompt: Make negative with ne ... pas: Mangez-en.
practice.explanation: En moves before the verb.

practice.prompt: Make negative with ne ... pas: Montre-le-moi.
practice.explanation: Moi becomes me and moves before le, ahead of the verb.

practice.prompt: Make negative with ne ... pas: Dépêche-toi.
practice.explanation: Te returns before the verb and no hyphen remains.

practice.prompt: Replace un stylo with en plus the quantity: Donne-moi un stylo.
practice.explanation: Moi becomes m' before en; keep un.

practice.prompt: Make negative with ne ... pas: Donnez-le-leur.
practice.explanation: Le precedes leur in normal preverbal order.

practice.prompt: Give the affirmative vous command of se souvenir, with no complement.
practice.explanation: Use souvenez and attach reflexive vous.

practice.prompt: Choose the spelling when en belongs to chercher, not to aller.
practice.explanation: Do not add s or a hyphen when en belongs to a following infinitive.

practice.prompt: Replace de cet outil with en: Sers-toi de cet outil.
practice.explanation: Toi becomes t' before attached en; retain the s already present in sers.

practice.prompt: Replace du courage with en: Aie du courage.
practice.explanation: The irregular tu command aie gains a linking s directly before en.

practice.prompt: Supply être as a nous command: ___ patients.
practice.explanation: Être has the irregular imperative soyons.

practice.prompt: Supply savoir as a vous command: ___ que vous pouvez nous appeler.
practice.explanation: The imperative is sachez, not the present savez.

practice.prompt: Invite the group, including yourself, to sit down. Give only the affirmative nous imperative of s'asseoir; either standard family is accepted.
practice.explanation: Both families retain the imperative nous ending and attach reflexive nous after a hyphen.

practice.prompt: Give only the negative tu imperative of s'asseoir with ne ... pas. Both standard families are accepted.
practice.explanation: Te elides before the verb and stays before it; both assieds and assois are standard.

practice.prompt: Build a command to one familiar person from va, te and changer, meaning go and get changed. Use those words only.
practice.explanation: Te belongs to the reflexive infinitive changer, so it precedes that infinitive without an imperative hyphen.

production_task.prompt: Give five instructions to a new volunteer. Include an affirmative reflexive command, a command with y, a command with en and two negative commands, one with an object pronoun.
production_task.model_answer: Installe-toi près de l'entrée. Le vestiaire est au fond: vas-y pour poser ton sac. Il reste des badges: prends-en un. Ne te dépêche pas. Le dossier est confidentiel: ne le montre pas aux visiteurs.
production_task.translation: Settle in near the entrance. The cloakroom is at the back: go there to put down your bag. There are badges left: take one. Don't hurry. The file is confidential: don't show it to visitors.
rubric: Use hyphens only in the affirmative attached-pronoun groups.
Check the added s before y/en where required.
Keep negative pronouns before the verb.
Make the instructions practical and unambiguous.
